summary: Retrieve the artists a user is a fan of
description: Returns the list of Jamendo artists a given user follows (currently only the 'fan' relation exists). The `relation` parameter is future‑proof but currently defaults to 'fan'. Results can be ordered by `updatedate` and include an optional `fullcount` header. The `client_id` parameter is mandatory and you must also provide either `id`, `access_token` or `name` to identify the user.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with format=json.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the given field(s). Append _asc or _desc for direction; default is ascending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds a header `results_fullcount` with the total number of rows without limit/offset. Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token of the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter results.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Relation type(s) to include. Currently only 'fan' is supported.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, warnings and results count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of user‑artist relationship objects, each containing user info and an `artists` sub‑array.

notes: At least one of `id`, `access_token` or `name` must be supplied alongside `client_id`.
`relation` defaults to `fan`; other values may be added in the future.
The `fullcount` parameter can significantly affect performance and is not available on heavy endpoints.
